sources.title: Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-mlm-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: gte-multilingual-mlm-base We introduce mGTE series, new generalized text encoder, embedding and reranking models that support 75 languages and the context length of up to 8192. The models are built upon the transformer++ encoder backbone (BERT + RoPE + GLU, code refer to Alibaba-NLP/new-impl) as well as the vocabulary of XLM-R.
